subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.

My friend Ragini /shall completed/ her task/ by then.
solution:
The correct answer is **'****shall completed'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in this sentence lies in the segment **"shall completed".**
 
• we use the future perfect tense to talk about an action that will have been completed at some point in the future. 
 
• The structure should be** "shall/will + have + past participle" **of a verb, so "shall completed" is incorrect.
 
• The correct sentence would be:** "My friend Ragini shall have completed her task by then." **

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "her task "** is correct as it provides the object for the action to be performed.
 
• **Option 3: "by then"** is also correct since it correctly depicts the time reference for the task completion.
 
• **Option 4: "My friend Ragini"** has no errors and properly introduces the subject of the sentence.
